name: Virtual Controllers
summary: Installs the driver that shows the client's controllers to games as Xbox or DualSense controllers.
description:
Installs the Sunshine Gamepad Driver (xgpad), which shows the client's controllers to games as Xbox Series X|S or DualSense controllers. Uninstalling the plugin removes the driver.

PlayStation controllers, and controllers with motion sensors or a touchpad, become DualSense controllers; the rest become Xbox Series controllers. Change this with Controller type, or switch during a stream from the Virtual Controllers page of the in-stream menu. Switching reconnects the controllers, so some games need a restart to notice.

Games that only support Xbox controllers see a DualSense only through Steam Input. Used when Windows Gamepad Drivers is All Available Drivers (the default; a licensed Virtual HID Driver takes precedence) or Sunshine Gamepad Driver (xgpad).
author: Sunshine
notice: Installing adds a self-signed certificate made for this release to the trusted certificates of this computer; its private key was destroyed after the driver was signed. Restart Sunshine after installing or uninstalling so controllers use the change.

options.label: Controller type
options.description: What controllers appear as when a stream starts. Automatic picks DualSense for PlayStation controllers and for controllers with motion sensors or a touchpad. Set Xbox for an application that only supports Xbox controllers.
